about: The pullboard loop as explicit state machines, derived from the code on 9 Nov 2026 (main a5e4562fee). docs/architecture.md, section State machines, is the same map in prose and tables; test/state-machines.test.js keeps both in step with the code. A citation is path:function. A harness is a test file, or NONE when nothing proves the row.

gaps.title: gate-drive jobs never check their item
gaps.criterion: A gate-drive job whose hand-off record is no longer queued or running, or whose item is not claimed by the hand-off's seat at its frozen digest, writes an ended step {stale:true}, is marked done and stops its gate at its next renewal tick; the dispatcher never admits such a ticket.

gaps.title: the fallback lists only kind gate
gaps.criterion: lapsedGateJobs lists kinds gate and gate-drive; a lapsed gate-drive job whose hand-off is ended, or whose item left its serving state, ends stale on the next next or status, never driven.

gaps.title: a running hand-off resumes with no item check
gaps.criterion: startSubmitHandoff on a running record checks the item is claimed by the record's seat at its digest, as it does for a queued one, and refuses SUBMIT_HANDOFF_CHANGED otherwise; the worker then ends the job.

gaps.title: the fallback's serving predicate is wrong for pre-submit gates
gaps.criterion: the active predicate takes the hand-off record: a queued or running gate serves claimed by its seat at its digest, and only a post-submit job serves submitted at its commit; a pre-submit gate for a claimed item is never ended stale.

gaps.title: review jobs outlive their item's review
gaps.criterion: verify, withdraw and reopen release the item's review job (step released, done) in the same transaction; reclaimLapsedReviews never extends a lease whose item is not submitted.

gaps.title: next resumes a held claim from a snapshot
gaps.criterion: next and next --take print you hold #N only after re-reading, in the board read that prints, that #N is claimed by this seat with a live lease; otherwise they fall through to selection.

gaps.title: next --wait shouts can hand out any item
gaps.criterion: a shout ends next --wait with a shout asks you to act on #N only when #N is open in this seat's lane, claimed by this seat, or reservable by it; any other shout is printed and the wait continues.

gaps.title: landing jobs and freed gate drivers never reach done
gaps.criterion: a failed landing run, a finish sequence stopped by LAND_PROOF_NOT_GREEN, and a gate driver freed by a signal each end with a failed or ended step and done, so no job row is left unowned and not done.

gaps.title: queued main-test jobs have no driver
gaps.criterion: a main-test job queued by receiptComparison is driven to a receipt or ended within one dispatcher pass after its lease would lapse.

gaps.title: pullboard merged runs twice
gaps.criterion: merged on an item that already has item_merged_commit refuses ALREADY_MERGED unless it names the same commit, which writes nothing.

gaps.title: reland is an undeclared move
gaps.criterion: reland is declared in MOVES with its guards and a real proof check, and docs/lifecycle.md shows it.

gaps.title: machine acceptance skips the accept guards
gaps.criterion: acceptMachineSubmission passes the accept move's state and notBuilder checks, and refuses NOT_SUBMITTED for an item that left submitted.

gaps.title: the red notice ignores a lapsed claim
gaps.criterion: queuedReds reads the item through current(), and the notice says the claim lapsed when it did.

gaps.title: a returned red is not tied to the current head
gaps.criterion: returnedRecord shows a red or infrastructure gate only when its commit and digest match the item's current head.

gaps.title: board import accepts undeclared statuses
gaps.criterion: restoreDocument refuses UNDECLARED_STATE for any item_status not in STATES before it inserts.

gaps.title: gate-verdict jobs never check their item
gaps.criterion: finishAwaitingVerdicts ends a job whose item is no longer submitted at its candidate with a withdrawn step and writes no verdict.

gaps.title: the P7 chaos gate is missing
gaps.criterion: the chaos test SPEC P7 names exists: it kills drivers and runner channels at random points and asserts every job finishes exactly once.
